verbs.note: Regular -ar verb. Its noun in this lesson is la extracción.

example.target: Ajustamos la programación del dispositivo en la clínica.
example.native: We adjust the device programming at the clinic.

verbs.note: Regular -ar verb.

example.target: A mi esposo le preocupa la cirugía.
example.native: The surgery worries my husband.

verbs.note: Usually works like gustar: me preocupa la cirugía. After entiendo que, use the subjunctive: entiendo que le preocupe.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Full Day Running the Procedure Suite
lessons.objective: Lead a full procedure day in Spanish: teach, adjust plans, handle an emergency, talk with patients and report.
lessons.speakingPrompt: You are the physician leading the procedure day, and the AI plays your team, patients, a state surveyor and the director: run the huddle, guide the trainer, talk with patients, answer the surveyor, return callbacks and dictate the report, using commands, subjunctive, conditionals and connectors.

items.note: Use el inspector estatal for a man.

items.target: Lucía, enséñale a abrir la bandeja sin contaminarla.
items.native: Lucía, show them how to open the tray without contaminating it.
items.note: Informal tú between coworkers.

items.target: Revisen la lista antes de que entre el primer paciente.
items.native: Check the list before the first patient comes in.
items.note: Ustedes command to the whole team.

items.target: Como no suspendió el anticoagulante, hoy no es seguro inyectar.
items.native: Since you didn't stop the blood thinner, it isn't safe to inject today.
items.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

items.target: Le daremos otra cita cuando su médico apruebe suspenderlo.
items.native: We'll give you another appointment when your doctor approves stopping it.

items.target: Acuéstese, señor; le vamos a levantar las piernas.
items.native: Lie down, sir; we're going to raise your legs.

items.target: Con gusto le muestro el registro de temperatura de esta semana.
items.native: I'll gladly show you this week's temperature log.
items.note: Formal with the surveyor.

items.target: ¿Cómo ha seguido desde la inyección de ayer?
items.native: How have you been since yesterday's injection?

items.target: En resumen, se realizaron 10 casos; sin embargo, se pospuso 1.
items.native: In summary, 10 cases were done; however, 1 was postponed.

passage.target: A las 7:00, la doctora Ramírez reúne al equipo en la Clínica del Dolor Valle Norte para el día de procedimientos.
passage.native: At 7:00, Dr. Ramírez gathers the team at Clínica del Dolor Valle Norte for the procedure day.

passage.target: La doctora les dice: Revisen la lista antes de que entre el primer paciente.
passage.native: The doctor tells them: Check the list before the first patient comes in.

passage.target: Además, les pide que confirmen la suspensión del anticoagulante de cada paciente según la orden del médico.
passage.native: She also asks them to confirm each patient's blood-thinner hold according to the doctor's order.

passage.target: Hoy Lucía Ferrer, ya con experiencia, está a cargo de la capacitación de Tomás, un enfermero del personal nuevo.
passage.native: Today Lucía Ferrer, now experienced, is in charge of the training of Tomás, a nurse from the new staff.

passage.target: La doctora le dice: Lucía, enséñale a abrir la bandeja sin contaminarla.
passage.native: The doctor tells her: Lucía, show him how to open the tray without contaminating it.

passage.target: Durante la revisión, Lucía descubre que el señor Ortega no suspendió su anticoagulante, aunque su cardiólogo se lo había indicado.
passage.native: During the review, Lucía discovers that Mr. Ortega did not stop his blood thinner, even though his cardiologist had told him to.

passage.target: La doctora le explica al paciente: Como no suspendió el anticoagulante, hoy no es seguro inyectar.
passage.native: The doctor explains to the patient: Since you didn't stop the blood thinner, it isn't safe to inject today.

passage.target: Luego le dice: Le daremos otra cita cuando su médico apruebe suspenderlo.
passage.native: Then she tells him: We'll give you another appointment when your doctor approves stopping it.

passage.target: Después le comenta a Tomás: Si el paciente hubiera suspendido el anticoagulante, lo habríamos inyectado hoy.
passage.native: Afterward she tells Tomás: If the patient had stopped the blood thinner, we would have injected him today.

passage.target: La recepcionista agenda el caso reprogramado para el próximo martes y avisa a la oficina del cardiólogo.
passage.native: The receptionist schedules the rescheduled case for next Tuesday and notifies the cardiologist's office.

passage.target: A media mañana, el señor Díaz se marea al sentarse en la camilla y tiene sudor frío después de su inyección.
passage.native: In the middle of the morning, Mr. Díaz gets dizzy when he sits up on the stretcher and has a cold sweat after his injection.

passage.target: Tomás nota la palidez del paciente, le toma los signos vitales y llama enseguida a la doctora, quien reconoce un episodio vasovagal.
passage.native: Tomás notices the patient's pallor, takes his vital signs and immediately calls the doctor, who recognizes a vasovagal episode.

passage.target: La doctora le dice: Acuéstese, señor; le vamos a levantar las piernas.
passage.native: The doctor tells him: Lie down, sir; we're going to raise your legs.

passage.target: Con la elevación de piernas, el señor Díaz se recupera en pocos minutos, y después Lucía le ofrece un jugo.
passage.native: With the leg elevation, Mr. Díaz recovers in a few minutes, and afterward Lucía offers him a juice.

passage.target: Al mediodía llega la inspectora estatal del departamento de salud, que quiere verificar el cumplimiento de las reglas para guardar medicamentos refrigerados.
passage.native: At noon the state surveyor from the health department arrives, and she wants to verify compliance with the rules for storing refrigerated medications.

passage.target: Durante la inspección, la doctora le responde: Con gusto le muestro el registro de temperatura de esta semana.
passage.native: During the inspection, the doctor answers her: I'll gladly show you this week's temperature log.

passage.target: Por la tarde, la doctora devuelve las llamadas pendientes y le pregunta a la señora Luna: ¿Cómo ha seguido desde la inyección de ayer?
passage.native: In the afternoon, the doctor returns the pending callbacks and asks Mrs. Luna: How have you been since yesterday's injection?

passage.target: En el cierre del día, la doctora le dicta el informe al director: En resumen, se realizaron 10 casos; sin embargo, se pospuso 1.
passage.native: At the end-of-day wrap-up, the doctor dictates the report to the director: In summary, 10 cases were done; however, 1 was postponed.

example.target: Revisen la lista antes de que entre el primer paciente.
example.native: Check the list before the first patient comes in.

verbs.note: Regular -ar verb. Revisen is the ustedes command a lead gives the crew.

example.target: El paciente suspende el anticoagulante según la orden del médico.
example.native: The patient stops the blood thinner according to the doctor's order.

verbs.note: Regular -er verb. Used for holding a medication before a procedure.

example.target: Acuéstese, señor; le vamos a levantar las piernas.
example.native: Lie down, sir; we're going to raise your legs.

verbs.note: Stem change o to ue (me acuesto), except nosotros. Acuéstese is the formal usted command.

example.target: Con gusto le muestro el registro de temperatura de esta semana.
example.native: I'll gladly show you this week's temperature log.

verbs.note: Stem change o to ue (muestro, muestras), except nosotros.

example.target: La doctora devuelve las llamadas pendientes por la tarde.
example.native: The doctor returns the pending callbacks in the afternoon.

verbs.note: Stem change o to ue (devuelvo, devuelves), except nosotros. Devolver la llamada means to return a call.
